notes:
THE ERROR WORTH THE MOST HERE is a straight inversion, not a fabrication: the entry tells you 'his Q cooldown is long but his shield is not'. Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6 and Soul Furnace is 15/14/13/12/11 — the shield is longer at every single rank. The entire trading plan in this matchup is 'only poke into an empty shield', so a reader who believes the shield outpaces the Q will conclude the window never opens and simply concede the lane. It does open, for about five seconds after every Soul Furnace.

Aurora's 'untargetability' appears again (spikes[2], mid, whys[4]) — third matchup in my slice with it. She has none; Across the Veil grants invisibility and Between Worlds grants a two-way teleport across a slowing zone. This phrase needs a repo-wide grep in champ-data/content/aurora.js.

'Between the Worlds' (extra 'the') again in the full layer.

Unstoppable Onslaught is flagged hardCC, slow, terrain, zone. Nothing in the entry mentions the ultimate at all, and it is the one ability in his kit that Aurora's slow and her rift cannot influence. I could not fit a treatment of it inside the length band without cutting something more useful, so it is recorded here.

Deliberately not asserted: whether Aurora can be knocked out of the Between Worlds rift by Decimating Smash mid-teleport, and whether Unstoppable Onslaught's knockup can be avoided by crossing the rift. Both are animation-priority questions that Riot's text does not answer and aurora.json needsResearch is empty.
